1.explanation: • discover_preview_images.lua is the Pandoc filter that picks off an element to use as the preview for the grid. If it misidentifies or only handles the first valid image, it may silently drop the second (punctuated) URL. • website-listing-template.ts is the front-end template that reads that preview image out of the AST/DOM and renders the tag in the grid. If it escapes or encodes the URL incorrectly (for example, mis-handling commas or colons), the browser will fail to fetch the preview. • core/url.ts contains the URL utilities (joinUrl, ensureProtocolAndTrailingSlash) used when normalizing or rewriting both remote and local image paths. Its logic doesn’t anticipate URIs with embedded commas or non-alphanumeric segments, so those URLs can get mangled before they reach the template and end up broken in the grid view.
1.bug_scenario: The user’s Quarto site contains a post that embeds two images—one from a remote URL that includes punctuation (commas and a colon) and one from a local relative path. When the post is rendered in the normal document flow (“inline”), both images display correctly, but when that same post is shown inside the automated “image grid” listing (the site listing page), the preview image for the remote/punctuation‐heavy URL is missing or broken.
